videos.title: Cal Poly & Logitech: Simplifying Campus Modernization
videos.description:
See how Cal Poly transformed its newly expanded 18,000 sq. ft. Center for Innovation and Entrepreneurship (CIE) into a high-impact, hybrid-ready hub for the next generation of student entrepreneurs. From empty rooms to fully equipped meeting spaces, private offices, and event areas, Logitech technology—including Rally Bar, Rally Bar AI Pro, Mevo camera kits, and personal workspace solutions—helps Cal Poly simplify campus modernization.

videos.title: You've Got Options | Motion capture in product design | Logitech
videos.description:
Ever wonder how Logitech designs devices that feel tailored to your hand? Discover how motion capture in product design transforms movement into data.

Joe visits Logitech in Cork, Ireland, to explore the high-tech Motion Capture System with Senior CAD Engineer Corey Levin. Learn how 3D optical motion capture tracks reflective markers, while overhead thermal cameras map contact points to generate billions of data points for advanced computational models.
